why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 must FAIL because a build that adds only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented, while the request asks for a complete list. The output meets it. Line 3 is "FAIL", and its evidence says README.md "lists only capitalize and truncate; slugify, exported from index.js, has no section." It adds that "a PR that adds only a '## padLeft(s, width, fill)' section meets this line, and the README is still incomplete." It also proposes the missing line: a section for every exported function. The wrong_build makes the same point ("Leave slugify undocumented"). The other lines' results don't conflict with this item.
